name: SaaS Subscription Management
description: SaaS business database with subscription plans, customer accounts, and invoicing. Practice recurring revenue analysis and churn metrics.

tables.name: plans
tables.description: Subscription plan tiers with pricing and seat limits

tables.name: subscriptions
tables.description: Customer subscription records with plan details and renewal tracking

tables.name: invoices
tables.description: Billing invoices with payment status tracking

relationships.description: Each subscription is for one plan tier
Each invoice belongs to one subscription

sample_queries.title: Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR)
sample_queries.description: Calculate total MRR by plan tier from active subscriptions
sample_queries.sql:
SELECT 
  p.plan_name,
  COUNT(s.subscription_id) as active_subscriptions,
  SUM(s.seats_purchased) as total_seats,
  SUM(s.seats_purchased * p.monthly_price_usd) as monthly_recurring_revenue
FROM plans p
JOIN subscriptions s ON p.plan_id = s.plan_id
WHERE s.status = 'Active'
GROUP BY p.plan_id, p.plan_name
ORDER BY monthly_recurring_revenue DESC;

sample_queries.title: Churn Risk Analysis
sample_queries.description: Identify subscriptions approaching renewal with payment issues
sample_queries.sql:
SELECT 
  s.company_name,
  p.plan_name,
  s.renewal_date,
  DATE_DIFF('day', CURRENT_DATE, s.renewal_date) as days_to_renewal,
  COUNT(i.invoice_id) as total_invoices,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.payment_status = 'Failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failed_payments,
  s.seats_purchased * p.monthly_price_usd as mrr_at_risk
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN plans p ON s.plan_id = p.plan_id
LEFT JOIN invoices i ON s.subscription_id = i.subscription_id
WHERE s.status = 'Active' 
  AND s.renewal_date <= CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL 30 DAY
GROUP BY s.subscription_id, s.company_name, p.plan_name, s.renewal_date, s.seats_purchased, p.monthly_price_usd
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN i.payment_status = 'Failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY mrr_at_risk DESC;

sample_queries.title: Revenue by Target Audience
sample_queries.description: Compare revenue across different customer segments
sample_queries.sql:
SELECT 
  p.target_audience,
  COUNT(s.subscription_id) as customer_count,
  SUM(s.seats_purchased * p.monthly_price_usd) as total_mrr,
  AVG(s.seats_purchased) as avg_seats_per_customer
FROM plans p
JOIN subscriptions s ON p.plan_id = s.plan_id
WHERE s.status = 'Active'
GROUP BY p.target_audience
ORDER BY total_mrr DESC;

sample_queries.title: Payment Collection Rate
sample_queries.description: Invoice payment success rate by month
sample_queries.sql:
SELECT 
  DATE_TRUNC('month', invoice_date) as month,
  COUNT(*) as total_invoices,
  SUM(CASE WHEN payment_status = 'Paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as paid_invoices,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN payment_status = 'Paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) as payment_success_rate,
  SUM(amount_usd) as total_billed,
  SUM(CASE WHEN payment_status = 'Paid' THEN amount_usd ELSE 0 END) as total_collected
FROM invoices
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month DESC;
